lines: Private companies Small companies are the backbone of local economies . 22.9 million , according to the U.S. Small Business Administration . Small businesses provide 75 percent of the net new jobs added to the economy , and represent 99.7 percent of all employers . More than half of the private work force is employed by a small business , which accounted for 52 percent of the private sector output .
